weapon_note: empty hands, open fingers — the default, and the only variant that commits to nothing, so the character pass is free to add any prop
prop_policy: the proxy blocks body mechanics; the prop belongs to the character pass and comes from the character's own reference
so the default is empty hands — a weapon drawn here is a weapon the character pass inherits, right down to an unarmed character growing blades
add one only when the weapon is part of the arc or the mass: a long shaft, a bow, a two-handed grip
front_markers: leather harness in a V meeting a brass ring at the sternum
back_markers: dark leather back panel with light X lacing over the shoulder blades
vertical spine seam from the neck to the waist
stained walnut nape over the lower part of the back of the head
heel pad instead of a toe split
profile_markers: rear half of the torso is the leather panel, front half pale wood
nape stained on the back of the skull
toes point the way the figure faces
invariants: front and back share one silhouette on purpose: the character pass inherits the proxy silhouette, so an extra bump becomes a backpack
identical head-to-heel height and pixel scale in all four views
one arm and one leg in the profile views
every weapon shares the body pose, so variants stay comparable
rule: the difference between the two sides is material, never outline
